Assume the pipe is smooth with absolute roughness ε = 0 mm.
Assume the oil density is ρ = 900 kg/m³.
Assume the oil dynamic viscosity is μ = 0.1 Pa·s.
The Reynolds number is Re = 900 × 1.5 × 0.08 / 0.1 = 1080.
The flow is laminar because Re < 2300.
Use the laminar friction factor relation f = 64 / Re = 64 / 1080 = 0.0593.
Use the Darcy–Weisbach equation Δp = f × (L/D) × (ρ v² / 2).
L/D = 25 / 0.08 = 312.5.
ρ v² / 2 = 900 × 1.5² / 2 = 1012.5 Pa.
Δp = 0.0593 × 312.5 × 1012.5 = 18750 Pa.
Do not use f = 0.03.
The pressure drop is approximately 18.75 kPa.
